latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the api-gateway skill.

- Connect to 100+ third-party APIs (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GitHub, Slack, Notion, Airtable, HubSpot, etc.) using managed user OAuth via Maton.
- Securely proxy native API calls through a unified gateway, requiring only a Maton API key and user-granted OAuth authorization.
- Manage connections (list, create, get, delete) via a dedicated control API.
- Supports environment variable authentication and allows specifying which connection to use per request.
- Comprehensive documentation and code samples for quick start and advanced usage.
